profile.summary: 1 Direction is an education support organization based in Eastvale, California, with an office in Atlanta, Georgia. It runs year-round summer and after-school programs, tutoring and mentoring, parent engagement workshops and professional development for educators. It serves schools and families in California and Georgia.
